cases.expected: A truncated or uncertified generated catalog is not globally optimal or execution eligible.
A reserved transform operation without an authenticated matching transformation certificate is rejected.
A value-changing transform carries an explicit loss and uncertainty policy and cannot silently reuse a known input uncertainty model.
An alternative is reported only when its exact producer output satisfies the contested requirement use.
Coverage is metadata-derived and executable; exact fetched bytes enter a post-fetch bound identity.
Descriptor, runtime, and commit agree on affine axes, signed orientation, aggregation, and CRS.
Duplicate packet results are idempotent, conflicting replay fails, and NOT_ATTEMPTED consumes no attempt.
Restart reconstructs or fences active reservations before any new dispatch.
Live scheduling ranks ready heads from the entire immutable dependency graph.
squeue absence plus unavailable sacct remains unknown and cannot authorize sbatch.
Only a validated authoritative artifact can be projected into Cube entries and lineage through an idempotent outbox.
A mid-transfer crash reuses verified completed assets, and every reopened asset consumes a new durable call/byte reservation before provider access.
Two same-node fetchers cannot concurrently transfer one manifest; process death releases ownership without erasing checkpoints.
An expired packet fence is released without consuming retry sequence only after the exact RuntimeStore run proves zero launch/commit evidence under the exclusive controller lock.
Lease expiry cannot discard the exact terminal result of the packet's already-bound runtime run.
A real Slurm deployment is never claimed from fake-scheduler evidence; validation requires an authorized provisioned site.

A self-consistent projection receipt is not artifact authority; publication requires a ProjectionAuthority minted only after the manifest is re-read and the object re-hashed, bound to that exact artifact.
